business_analysis.problem_statement: From 2026, vehicles between 2.5T and 3.5T used for international transport now require smart tachographs. Thousands of UK small operators (couriers, tradespeople, small food distributors doing Ireland-UK runs) are newly in scope. Existing tachograph compliance software is complex and expensive, built for HGV operators.
business_analysis.target_buyer: Owner-operator of a small UK courier or delivery company doing international cross-border runs with 2.5-3.5T vans
business_analysis.trigger_event: DVSA roadside check, new vehicle purchase with smart tachograph, freight customer requiring compliance documentation
business_analysis.current_workaround: Manual driver log books (now insufficient for international), Excel tracking
business_analysis.competitor_summary: Convey, Tachomaster (built for HGV, overly complex for 2.5T operators)

technical_analysis.suggested_architecture: Mobile app: tachograph data upload (via USB reader or manual entry), driver hours calculator, DVSA compliance report
ai_components: Driver hours infringement detection from tachograph data
required_integrations: Smart tachograph data file parsing (DTG format)
technical_analysis.maintenance_expectations: Medium — DVSA rules and tachograph data formats update periodically

business_analysis.problem_statement: 70%+ large UK companies say they will require more detailed ESG data from suppliers by 2026. UK SRS published February 2026. SMEs face indirect supply chain pressure: losing contracts if they cannot provide carbon, energy, and governance data to procurement teams. Most SMEs have no system and respond to each questionnaire ad-hoc.
business_analysis.target_buyer: Owner or operations manager of a UK SME supplying large corporate customers who are beginning to issue ESG questionnaires
business_analysis.trigger_event: Procurement questionnaire from major customer, ESG requirement in tender specification, ISO 14001 audit prep
business_analysis.current_workaround: Manually answering procurement questionnaires, hiring sustainability consultant for one-off exercises
business_analysis.competitor_summary: Sedex (large enterprise), EcoVadis (expensive), Zevero (UK carbon, emerging). Gap for simple £50-100/month SME tool.

technical_analysis.suggested_architecture: Web app: ESG data input wizard, metrics tracking, questionnaire response generator, carbon footprint calculator
ai_components: Questionnaire auto-fill from stored company data
Carbon footprint estimation from activity inputs
technical_analysis.maintenance_expectations: Low — BEIS emission factors update annually

core_features: Annual ESG data collection wizard (energy, water, waste, carbon)
Carbon footprint calculator using BEIS emission factors
Supplier ESG profile PDF for customer submission
Questionnaire answer bank (answer once, reuse)
features_to_fake_manually: Customer questionnaire mapping done manually per customer format
mvp_definition.four_week_scope: Data collection wizard, carbon calculator, basic PDF report
mvp_definition.eight_week_scope: Answer bank, multi-customer questionnaire mapping, year-over-year tracking

commercial_analysis.distribution_strategy: Make UK, FSB, chambers of commerce, LinkedIn targeting operations managers
